claims.statement: Workflow on selects triggering events, including one or multiple events or schedules, with file/ref restrictions described by dependent sections. Included event examples and linked event reference require separate review; a trigger definition is not proof of a run.

A skipped job reports Success and does not block PR merging even when required. Native status acceptance must not be confused with proof the underlying obligation executed; enforcement testing must exercise skipped paths.

Changed-path filters apply to push and pull_request but are not evaluated for tag pushes. Include and ignore path keys are mutually exclusive for the same event; mixed filtering uses include patterns with negatives.

Ordered negative path matches exclude earlier inclusion and later positives re-include. Branch and path filters require both predicates; path matching uses wildcard globs rather than arbitrary regular expressions. Linked syntax remains separate evidence.
